items.headline: Stocks Decline Amid Inflation Fears and Soaring Oil Prices
items.summary: U.S. equities closed lower on Thursday, extending a multi-session pullback, as hotter-than-expected Producer Price Index data for August fueled inflation concerns and pushed Treasury yields higher. Brent crude surged past $100 a barrel, exacerbating worries about energy costs and the potential for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike. All major indices finished in the red, reflecting cautious investor sentiment ahead of tomorrow's Consumer Price Index release. Not financial advice.

items.headline: Apple Rises Post-Product Event
items.summary: Shares of Apple ($AAPL) climbed following its product event yesterday, where it launched a new folding iPhone.

items.headline: SentinelOne Sees Strong Bounce
items.summary: SentinelOne, Inc. ($S) experienced a significant rebound today, with its stock rising over 3%.

items.headline: Nvidia Shares Decline
items.summary: Nvidia ($NVDA) stock fell over 2% today amidst broader market declines.

items.headline: American Eagle Outfitters Drops Premarket
items.summary: American Eagle Outfitters shares fell premarket after the company maintained its annual comparable sales forecast, indicating potential margin concerns.

items.headline: August PPI Higher Than Expected, Fueling Rate Hike Bets
items.summary: The Producer Price Index (PPI) for August rose 0.4% month-over-month, matching Dow Jones estimates, but climbed 5.4% year-over-year, slightly exceeding expectations of 5.3%. This data reinforced investor concerns about persistent inflation and increased the likelihood of a Federal Reserve rate hike this month, with traders seeing a 62.2% chance.

items.headline: Brent Crude Tops $100 Amid Middle East Tensions
items.summary: Brent crude futures surged above $100 a barrel for the first time since July, reaching prices near $107.35. This increase is attributed to escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, particularly renewed Iran-U.S. attacks near the Strait of Hormuz, which are raising concerns about energy supply risks.

items.headline: Treasury Yields Climb to Multi-Year Highs
items.summary: The benchmark 10-year U.S. Treasury yield rose to 4.8508%, marking its highest level since November 2023. This increase in yields pressured equity markets, as investors sought safer assets amid inflation fears and expectations of tighter monetary policy.

items.headline: CPI and Key Earnings Ahead
items.summary: Investors are closely watching for the release of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) report on Friday, which is expected to provide further insights into inflation trends. Additionally, Oracle ($ORCL) and Adobe ($ADBE) are among the major companies scheduled to report earnings today.

items.headline: Energy Sector Leads as Industrials and Consumer Discretionary Lag
items.summary: The Energy Select Sector SPDR ($XLE) advanced 1.1% today, benefiting from surging oil prices. In contrast, several sectors underperformed, with Industrials Select Sector SPDR ($XLI) declining 1.5%, Consumer Discretionary Select Sector SPDR ($XLY) falling 1.2%, and Utilities Select Sector SPDR ($XLU) dropping 1.1%.
